_about: The Photos page (/photos/). Each photo's original is private/documents/photos/<file>.jpg (never uploaded). After adding or changing one here, run: powershell -File scripts/make-photos.ps1 to make the web copies. Captions are Patrick's facts only.
intro: Moments from my Army Reserve service.

photos.alt: A crew member in a flight helmet kneels on the open rear ramp of a Chinook helicopter in flight, looking out over green farmland.
photos.caption: On the open ramp of a CH-47 Chinook in flight.

photos.alt: A crew member sits on the open rear ramp of a Chinook in flight, with fields and a winding river far below.
photos.caption: The view from the back of a Chinook.

photos.alt: Three soldiers seen from behind connect a black fuel hose to the side of a parked Chinook in a grassy field.
photos.caption: Connecting the fuel hose to a Chinook.

photos.alt: Two soldiers hold a fuel hose running into a parked Chinook while a crew member in a flight helmet stands nearby.
photos.caption: Fuel handlers and aircrew at work.

photos.alt: A Chinook sits in an open field on an overcast day while a group of soldiers stands beside a fuel hose and fire extinguisher.
photos.caption: Getting ready to refuel in the field.

photos.alt: A soldier talks to a group gathered at the open rear ramp of a Chinook in a field of tall dry grass.
photos.caption: A briefing at the back of the aircraft.

photos.alt: A Chinook parked on a sunny flight line with a fuel panel open on its side.
photos.caption: A Chinook on the flight line.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark salutes an officer during a ceremony while a soldier holds the unit flag and a formation stands behind them.
photos.caption: Change of command ceremony.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark stands at attention facing an officer while a soldier holds the unit flag beside him.
photos.caption: Taking command.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark shakes hands with a newly promoted sergeant in front of the formation.
photos.caption: Congratulating a Soldier on his promotion from Specialist to Sergeant.

photos.alt: Soldiers gather around a folding table in a pine forest camp with green tents behind them, looking at items laid out on the table.
photos.caption: Training in the field.
